title: Approach BMW Headquarters - BMW Group
content: # How to visit the BMW Group headquarters. It is the home of our technological expertise and drive for innovation. ## The Petuelring main entrance or the Dostlerstraße entrance. Shortly after the exit, the main entrance of the BMW Group headquarters will be on your right. **Coming from the other direction**,drive up Mittlerer Ring and follow the signs in the direction of BMW Welt/Lerchenauer Straße/Feldmoching. Make sure to merge onto Petuelring to reach the entrance to the BMW Group headquarters. If you fly to Munich, you can use either of the S-Bahn (urban train) lines S1 or S8 from the airport into Munich downtown and change at Marienplatz onto the U3, direction Moosach, and get off at the Olympiazentrum station. When arriving on public transport, please check in at the Dostlerstraße reception desk, which is opposite the entrance to BMW Plant 1.1. Please register in good time at the Dostlerstraße reception desk in the right-hand section of the foyer at BMW Group headquarters.
